title: FireSight source registry
purpose: Every dataset shown in the app, where it came from, how it was extracted, and how far it has been verified. If a number on screen is not traceable here, it should not be on screen.
retrievalMethod: Files downloaded manually in a browser from psi.nasa.gov (Science Documents, Experimental table and Reference Data folders) by a team member, then placed in data/raw/ (not committed to git). Investigation metadata was read from the PSI site's own search endpoint.

psiInvestigations.licenceFromRegistry: 16 of the 19 investigations have a DOI record in DataCite listing Creative Commons Zero v1.0 Universal (CC0 1.0, a public-domain dedication): https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/legalcode
noLicenceListed: PSI-10 ACME Flame Design (DOI exists, no rights field)
PSI-20 ACME BRE (no DOI record found)
PSI-22 ACME E-FIELD Flames (no DOI record found)
psiInvestigations.dataUserAgreement: A team member clicked a download button on a PSI investigation page and no Data User Agreement dialog appeared. PSI's site code does contain agreement text for some download paths, so this is not proof that no terms apply.
psiInvestigations.howCited: PSI's own BibTeX download uses: Authors. "Title", NASA PSI Data Repository, Version N, http://doi.org/DOI. Per-investigation citation strings are in data/real/citations.json (built by scripts/real/fetch-citations.ts). Use PSI's BibTeX where it differs; it is authoritative. Verified against PSI-25's BibTeX: identical except PSI appends the acronym to the title.
psiInvestigations.note: CC0 waives copyright, so attribution is not a legal condition, but the team cites every dataset anyway so each number is traceable. For BRE and E-FIELD, cite the PSI accession and page URL and avoid claiming a licence.

ntrsPapers.action: Open each paper's NTRS record and read its Rights / Copyright / Distribution field. We only quote table values with the paper, table and page, not whole documents.

nasaWebPages.action: Confirm NASA's media usage guidelines for quoting values from the ECLSS brief and MSIS pages, which we cite with links.

psiMetadata.pageUrlPattern: https://psi.nasa.gov/physci/repo/data/investigations/PSI-<number> (note: 'investigations', plural, as in PSI's own BibTeX; earlier notes used the singular)
psiMetadata.what: Names, acronyms, accession IDs, hardware, platform, dates, objectives, approach and publication lists for the 19 microgravity combustion investigations (24 combustion-science records in total, 5 of them ground-based).
psiMetadata.note: Read-only JSON endpoint used by the PSI website's own front end. It is not a documented public API and could change. The study and file listing endpoints returned 403 to anonymous requests and were not used.
psiMetadata.verification: Not yet compared line by line; derived from a single response.

pressurePolicy.rule: Measured pressure and cited-nominal pressure are never merged. A value is either 'measured in the source', 'supplied by a cited paper', or 'not recorded'.
measured: Saffire IV-VI (kPa per sample, published paper)
suppliedByPaper: Saffire I, II, III: 100 kPa in the thin-sample table (paper not yet identified, see saffire-iv-vi-tests.json)
notRecorded: BRE (the source says pressure was varied but not identified)
Saffire I, II, III in the PSI tables themselves
